text.en: Every licence for the use of a place as a burial or place of cremaor tion shall be substantially in the form in the Second Schedule and shall of state the class or community to which the use of such place is open.

Every application for a licence shall be made to the Officer in of the Land Office of the district, or, if the burial ground is within the limits of a Municipal Board area to the Chairman of such and shall be accompanied by a plan of the land applied for.
